data.name: Rodina
data.gender_notes: Rodina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic word ‘rod’, meaning ‘family’ or ‘lineage’. In Christian tradition, Rodina can represent the nurturing and protective role of God, the divine mother who watches over and guides her children. The name Rodina carries the meaning “Ruler, protector, mother” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rodina usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler, protector, mother and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine motherhood and protection.
data.etymology: Rodina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler, protector, mother.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rodina total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_english.long_meaning: A name of Slavic origin, derived from the word 'rod', meaning 'little' and 'counselor'. It can be translated as 'little counselor' or 'little rod'. In English usage, it is not directly related to the biblical name 'Rodina'.

data.cultural_impact: Rodina holds a deep cultural significance for many Eastern European communities rooted in Slavic traditions. It is an essential concept that represents not only the biological and extended family but also the ties that bind individuals to their homeland and ethnicity. This name reminds us of the importance of nurturing and protecting the bonds that form the foundation of our heritage and community.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian spirituality, Rodina takes on a transcendent and sanctifying role, representing the protective, nurturing, and loving presence of God, much like the maternal figure of the Virgin Mary. This name symbolizes the maternal love, care, and guidance that we can find in our divine mother, offering comfort and strength in times of need, and watching over us like a loving parent. Rodina calls us to trust in the protective love of God, who nurtures us like a mother and guides us through the twists and turns of life.
